Research provenance: Zhamaliyeva L, Batyrova A, Ablakimova N, Veklenko G, Kudaibergenova S, Grjibovski AM. Frontiers in Public Health 2026, DOI 10.3389/fpubh.2026.1955488, received 2026-08-01 and accepted 2026-10-25; final formatted text pending. Multilingual Kazakhstan validation N1000 total, Russian-speaking N500 and Kazakh-speaking N500, forward-back translation and EFA. Russian final 8-item personal-stigma scale alpha .71 / omega .71; correlated research samples not independent trials.
DB locales: Not in 149 live published keys / 234 versions (EN154 RU80 ES0), 11_DB_Registered or original GitHub PR495 research family; research only.
EN form: Parent ANU original English Depression Stigma Scale has two 9-item subscales; 2026 RU-KZ 8-item form is NOT an independently validated new English short form.

Original ANU DSS combines personal and perceived stigma in 18 items; here only adapted personal scale 8. No clinical screening/diagnosis, score thresholds, copy of items or cross-language equivalence. Publication early/accepted 2026-10-25.

Research provenance: Zhamaliyeva et al. Frontiers in Public Health 2026, DOI 10.3389/fpubh.2026.1955488, accepted 2026-10-25. Same N1000 Kazakhstan study as Russian version; Kazakh-speaking N500, forward-back translation, EFA, alpha .78 and omega .78 for final 7 items. ES form: No new ES translation validation for this exact seven-item Kazakh adaptation.

Instrument (EN): Trait Meta-Mood Scale — 24-item Colombian adult Spanish population validation
Scales / measured domains (EN): Attention to feelings (8), emotional clarity (8), emotional repair / mood repair (8). Three self-reported perceived emotional intelligence domains; NOT an emotion-ability performance test or diagnostic screen.
Research provenance: Baquero-Sierra A, Montoya CE, Grau Gonzalez I, Ortega LA. Journal of Psychoeducational Assessment, online 2026-07-27, DOI 10.1177/07342829261469035. N2428 adults in Bogotá Colombia. Three-factor validation omega >.88, gender measurement invariance, correlations with life satisfaction and psychological inflexibility; item 5 poor performance. Existing Fernández-Berrocal Extremera Ramos 2004 Spanish 24-item edition (DOI 10.2466/pr0.94.3.751-755), NOT newly translated into Colombian Spanish.
DB locales: Not published in live Supabase 149/234, 11_DB_Registered, or earlier full 3936 Master keys; locale-specific research evidence, original Spanish questionnaire pre-exists.
EN form: Parent Salovey et al. 1995 48-item English TMMS is separate. Colombia study article language EN DOES NOT certify a newly validated EN 24-item instrument.
RU form: No new RU respondent-version validation established from this study.
ES form: ES-CO: 2026 population psychometric evidence on EXISTING 24-item Spanish TMMS version among Bogotá adults N2428. NOT a new translated item set; previous ES-ES 2004 validation N292. Exact respondent-administered item text and Colombian wording require examination.
Other translations: Spanish-language origin ES-ES 2004; distinct ES-CO adult psychometric evidence 2026, NOT proof of independent local linguistic translation. Does not establish ES-MX, ES-AR or pan-Hispanic score invariance.
Target population: Adults in Bogotá Colombia N2428. Gender invariance supported there; age/clinical settings/other Colombian regions not automatically represented.
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Publisher article restricted and copyright reserved; catalogue third-party 'open with attribution' not binding for hosted commercial item text, translations, scoring or normative feedback. Confirm rights with TMMS-24 authors, item wording, exact scores and permitted commercial online use; item 5 deserves review, not unilateral removal.
Verification notes / safety gate: RESEARCH_ONLY / PERMISSION_REQUIRED. Same existing Spanish TMMS-24 item family and NEW Colombian adult validation evidence, not a newly created ES language translation. N2428, 3 factors, omega>.88, one problematic item 5; no automatic removal/scoring change, clinical cutoffs, published questionnaire text or activation.
